name: The Major ArcanAI
description: A 40-card humorous oracle deck of sarcastic skeletons in ornate black-and-white line art. Twelve classic major arcana anchor a deck of cards life actually deals you.

cards.name: The Zero of Fucks
cards.meaning: Let go of expectations and pressure. Step into freedom and a fresh start.
cards.reversed: You claim you don't care. You absolutely do. Admit it.
cards.situations: Walking away without drama, starting over somewhere new, no longer auditioning for anyone's approval.
cards.situations_reversed: Performing indifference, pretending to be over it while checking on them nightly.

cards.name: The Burned Bridge
cards.meaning: Not everything is meant to be saved. Some endings are necessary.
cards.reversed: You lit this one too soon. Some bridges deserve an apology and a rebuild.
cards.situations: Cutting someone off for good, leaving a job badly, blocking a number, a friendship past repair.
cards.situations_reversed: Regretting how you ended it, wanting to apologise, wondering whether to reach out again.

cards.name: The Two of Deez
cards.meaning: Stand confidently on your own. You don't need validation.
cards.reversed: Fishing for validation again. Deez are not for external approval.
cards.situations: Making a decision nobody approves of, backing yourself, ignoring the group chat's opinion of your life.
cards.situations_reversed: Fishing for compliments, posting for reassurance, asking six people until one of them agrees.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.meaning: Deep connection — romantic, platonic, or with yourself.
cards.reversed: Disconnection. You're kissing distance from someone you stopped seeing.
cards.situations: Dating someone seriously, choosing a partner, whether to commit, a friendship that genuinely matters.
cards.situations_reversed: Drifting apart in the same bed, a relationship gone quiet, roommates who used to be in love.

cards.name: The Iced Coffee
cards.meaning: Wake up. Face reality. Do what needs to be done.
cards.reversed: Decaf energy. You're running on fumes and calling it fine.
cards.situations: Getting through the morning, facing the thing you have avoided, deadlines, the errand you keep rescheduling.
cards.situations_reversed: Burnout, sleeping badly, too much caffeine and no rest, calling exhaustion a personality.

cards.name: Death
cards.meaning: Transformation through endings. Let the old version of you go.
cards.reversed: Clinging to the old you. Rigor mortis is not a personality.
cards.situations: A chapter closing, leaving a city or a marriage or a career, becoming someone your old friends would not recognise.
cards.situations_reversed: Clinging to who you used to be, keeping an old identity alive well past its expiry.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.meaning: Things are unclear. Trust your intuition and wait.
cards.reversed: The fog is self-made. Stop mistaking anxiety for intuition.
cards.situations: Mixed signals, not knowing where you stand, waiting on news, a gut feeling you cannot prove.
cards.situations_reversed: Anxiety dressed up as instinct, inventing motives, spiralling at night over something unconfirmed.

cards.name: Strength
cards.meaning: Inner calm and patience will carry you through.
cards.reversed: Forcing it. The lion calms down when you stop wrestling.
cards.situations: Keeping your temper with a difficult person, enduring a long hard stretch, restraint instead of force.
cards.situations_reversed: Snapping at last, patience running out, forcing something that needed waiting.

cards.name: Perseverance
cards.meaning: Keep going. You're closer than you think.
cards.reversed: Stubbornness isn't progress. Maybe it's the wrong staircase.
cards.situations: Late in a long project, months of job hunting, studying, wanting to quit near the finish.
cards.situations_reversed: Grinding away at something already dead, stubbornness mistaken for commitment.

cards.name: The Tea
cards.meaning: Truth is being revealed. Stay grounded.
cards.reversed: The gossip turned toxic. Spill less, sip more.
cards.situations: Gossip reaching you, finding something out, a secret surfacing, what people say once you leave the room.
cards.situations_reversed: Spreading it further, drama you are feeding, talking about people instead of to them.

cards.name: The Last Straw
cards.meaning: You've reached your limit. Change is inevitable.
cards.reversed: You keep declaring the last straw, then buying more straws.
cards.situations: The final incident, handing in your notice, ending it after one thing too many.
cards.situations_reversed: Threatening to leave and staying, raising your limit again, a last straw that keeps not being last.

cards.name: The Audacity
cards.meaning: Be bold. Take the risk.
cards.reversed: Bold in the wrong direction. Audacity without follow-through is just noise.
cards.situations: Asking for the raise, making the first move, applying anyway, saying the bold thing out loud.
cards.situations_reversed: Recklessness, nerve without a plan, or somebody else's gall aimed squarely at you.

cards.name: The Breast Pump
cards.meaning: You're overgiving. Rest and refill yourself.
cards.reversed: Running on empty and still giving. Refill the well first.
cards.situations: Caring for everyone else, new parenthood, being the one who always helps, running empty for others.
cards.situations_reversed: Resenting the people you keep giving to, martyrdom, keeping score of your own sacrifice.

cards.name: The Bottle
cards.meaning: Unexpressed emotions will surface eventually.
cards.reversed: It already burst. Clean up honestly instead of re-corking.
cards.situations: Swallowing what you feel, not saying it, holding it down until it comes out sideways.
cards.situations_reversed: The blow up, crying at the wrong moment, drinking to keep it down, saying it all badly at once.

cards.name: The Taco
cards.meaning: Find joy in small pleasures.
cards.reversed: Comfort became avoidance. The taco cannot fix this one.
cards.situations: A good meal, a small treat, cheap ordinary happiness, what to eat, plans with people you like.
cards.situations_reversed: Treating yourself instead of dealing with it, small pleasures used as avoidance.

cards.name: The Gold Shoulder
cards.meaning: Beware of ego and image obsession.
cards.reversed: The mirror is winning. Look outward for once.
cards.situations: Status, showing off, being seen with the right people, caring how it looks over how it is.
cards.situations_reversed: The ego cracking, humiliation, being found out as less impressive than the photographs.

cards.name: The Child
cards.meaning: Nurture your inner child.
cards.reversed: Your inner child is running the meeting. Adult supervision required.
cards.situations: Play, doing something purely for fun, what you loved at eight, taking yourself less seriously.
cards.situations_reversed: Sulking, tantrums, acting your shoe size, waiting for somebody to parent you.

cards.name: The Mother
cards.meaning: You also deserve care, not just others.
cards.reversed: Martyr mode. Care that costs you everything isn't care.
cards.situations: Looking after family, being the reliable one, nobody thinking to ask how you are.
cards.situations_reversed: Guilt for resting, smothering the people you love, care that has curdled into control.

cards.name: The Mom Boss
cards.meaning: You're doing too much. Let go of control.
cards.reversed: Delegation refused, burnout accepted. Put three of the six arms down.
cards.situations: Too many responsibilities, running everything, work and home both landing on you, delegating badly.
cards.situations_reversed: Micromanaging, refusing help, collapsing from insisting on doing all of it yourself.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.meaning: Withdraw and reflect.
cards.reversed: Solitude curdled into hiding. Crack the door open.
cards.situations: Cancelling plans, needing time alone, stepping back from people, wanting quiet instead of the noise.
cards.situations_reversed: Isolation, not answering anyone for weeks, loneliness dressed up as solitude.

cards.name: The Gardener
cards.meaning: Growth takes time. Keep nurturing.
cards.reversed: Overwatering. Some things only grow when you leave them alone.
cards.situations: Slow progress, a new job or skill or relationship still growing, patience with something planted recently.
cards.situations_reversed: Neglect, giving up before it grew, expecting a harvest a week after planting.

cards.name: The Cheese Fries
cards.meaning: You deserve enjoyment.
cards.reversed: All reward, no task. Earn the fries.
cards.situations: Indulgence, a night off, eating what you actually want, permission to enjoy something.
cards.situations_reversed: Overdoing it, comfort as anaesthetic, the regret that arrives after the binge.

cards.name: The Slice
cards.meaning: Release toxic attachments.
cards.reversed: You cut the wrong thread — or keep re-tying the one you cut.
cards.situations: Cutting someone loose, ending a draining friendship, removing yourself from a group that costs you.
cards.situations_reversed: Still attached, unable to make the cut, going back to the thing you keep ending.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.meaning: You are creative and abundant.
cards.reversed: Creative block by comparison. Make ugly things on purpose.
cards.situations: Making something, a project blooming, money coming in, fertility, having enough to be generous.
cards.situations_reversed: Creative block, scarcity thinking, hoarding, nothing you make ever feeling good enough.

cards.name: The Chicken Nugget
cards.meaning: Comfort and simplicity heal.
cards.reversed: Comfort became the whole menu. Vary the diet.
cards.situations: Wanting something easy, comfort food, keeping it simple, low effort care on a bad day.
cards.situations_reversed: Only ever comfort, avoiding anything difficult, the same safe thing every single night.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.meaning: Joy and truth are coming to light.
cards.reversed: Forced positivity. It's okay to sit in the shade sometimes.
cards.situations: Good news, things finally going well, feeling healthy again, a clear happy stretch.
cards.situations_reversed: Forced positivity, performing happiness you do not feel, good news that keeps not arriving.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.meaning: Trust your inner wisdom.
cards.reversed: You already know. You've known for months. Stop asking for signs.
cards.situations: Already knowing the answer underneath, a private instinct, something unsaid, trusting yourself over advice.
cards.situations_reversed: Ignoring what you already know, outsourcing the decision, a secret kept too long.

cards.name: The Zoom Meeting
cards.meaning: Disconnect from the fake, reconnect with real life.
cards.reversed: This could have been an email. So could your excuses.
cards.situations: Pointless meetings, remote work, screens all day, digital life crowding out the actual one.
cards.situations_reversed: Hiding behind the screen, camera off in every sense, avoiding contact with actual people.

cards.name: The Influencer
cards.meaning: Be authentic — image isn't everything.
cards.reversed: Performing a life instead of living one. Log off.
cards.situations: Curating how you appear, social media, comparing your life to posts, the personal brand.
cards.situations_reversed: Believing your own image, envying strangers online, the gap between the profile and the life.

cards.name: The Life of the Party
cards.meaning: Outward shine can hide inner loneliness.
cards.reversed: The mask slipped. Let someone see the tear.
cards.situations: Being the fun one, big social nights, everyone's favourite and nobody's confidant.
cards.situations_reversed: The comedown, lonely in a crowded room, going home alone after being on all night.

cards.name: The Last Hurrah
cards.meaning: A final celebration before an ending.
cards.reversed: The party's over and you're still holding the glass. Go home.
cards.situations: One last night, a leaving do, the final round before things change, a goodbye that is also a party.
cards.situations_reversed: Dragging it out, one more that is never the last, refusing to let the ending happen.

cards.name: The Dead End Job
cards.meaning: Don't stay stuck in something meaningless.
cards.reversed: The exit exists. You've just memorized the wallpaper.
cards.situations: A job going nowhere, quitting, stuck in a role or a town or a relationship with no future.
cards.situations_reversed: Staying for the money, comfortable and wasted, waiting to be pushed instead of jumping.

cards.name: The Fiddle-Leaf Fig
cards.meaning: Balance appearance with reality.
cards.reversed: All price tag, no roots. Get real or get repotted.
cards.situations: Looking fine and not being fine, a life that photographs better than it lives.
cards.situations_reversed: Neglect behind the presentation, the thing quietly dying while it still looks green.

cards.name: The Star
cards.meaning: Hope and healing are ahead.
cards.reversed: Hope deferred. Healing isn't linear — pour anyway.
cards.situations: Recovery after a bad run, faith returning, the first good news in a while, reasons to keep going.
cards.situations_reversed: Losing hope, cynicism, believing honestly that it is never going to improve.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.meaning: Break free from unhealthy cycles.
cards.reversed: Back in the cuffs, voluntarily. You know the way out; you've walked it before.
cards.situations: The habit you keep going back to, addiction, the person who is bad for you, the cage with its door open.
cards.situations_reversed: Deeper in, choosing it again, telling yourself you could stop any time you wanted.

cards.name: The Fair Weather Friend
cards.meaning: Reevaluate shallow relationships.
cards.reversed: Plot twist: you might be the one holding the umbrella. Check.
cards.situations: Friends who vanish when it gets hard, one sided effort, who actually shows up for you.
cards.situations_reversed: Being that friend yourself, going quiet on someone who is in trouble.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.meaning: Breakdown leads to breakthrough.
cards.reversed: Postponing the collapse. Controlled demolition beats waiting for lightning.
cards.situations: Sudden collapse, redundancy, a breakup out of nowhere, the business failing, everything changing at once.
cards.situations_reversed: The slow collapse you can see coming, propping up what should be allowed to fall.

cards.name: The Drama Queen
cards.meaning: Not everything is a crisis. Check the story you're telling yourself.
cards.reversed: Suppressed feelings staging a coup. A little drama is honest.
cards.situations: Overreacting, catastrophising, making it bigger than it is, a story you have told yourself too often.
cards.situations_reversed: A real crisis waved off as drama, nobody believing you on the one occasion it counts.

cards.name: The Last Flying Fuck
cards.meaning: Watch it go. Some things no longer deserve your energy.
cards.reversed: You let it go too fast. Some things deserved your care.
cards.situations: Letting go of what does not deserve you, boundaries, refusing to care about it any more.
cards.situations_reversed: Caring loudly about not caring, spite, energy spent proving you have moved on.

cards.name: The Nap
cards.meaning: Rest is productive. Lie down.
cards.reversed: Rest became hiding. Get up, hydrate, face one thing.
cards.situations: Exhaustion, needing sleep, overwork, a day off, your body asking you to stop.
cards.situations_reversed: Sleeping to avoid it, oversleeping, tired no matter how long you stay lying down.
